test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Exaggerate’ from the given sentence.

Rajni did understate Sheila’s embroider work as, according to her, it was worthless to decorate a piece of cloth with abstract ideas and then elaborate it to the audience on the stage.
solution:
The solution is **Understate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Exaggerate’ is Understate.
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is a correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Antonym - **Antonym is opposite of the given word.
 
• **Antonym **of **Elaborate **is **simple.**
 
• Antonym of **Embroidery **is **simplification.**
 
• Antonym of **Decorate **is **blemish.**
